page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head "Cap. i. Jugulum Caufæ." at top; page number 184 at top right (handwritten-looking, printed number); signature "A 4" at foot centre-left with catchword "Luthero" at right below the last line.

main_text.l: imperium Papale, licet accifum tertiâ fui parte
per Lutheri, Zuinglii, & Calvini prædica-
tionem, quàm stetit ante. Cum enim antea
corpus Ecclesiæ Romanæ plus vitiis intercutibus
laboraret quam hodie, & insuper sæviret
in propria viscera, nunc ab hostibus externis
pulsatum, sed animis & viribus unitum majori
cum robore propulsat injuriam quancunque
externam à Protestantibus illatam: tan-
toque firmius stat hodie Papale imperium,
quod hæc deliramenta Romanensium doctri-
narum, licet potissimam suam authoritatem
deberent tempore Lutheri (& ut hodie usu
venit) fulgori imperii Papalis longé floren-
tissimi; attamen nullo fuco probabilitatis &
similitudinis veri & boni obducta essent per
artes aut Concilii Tridentini aut Baroniorum
& Bellarminorum, nullaque extarct norma
fidei Romanæ, qualem postmodum Synodus
illa feralis nobis exhibuit, quam populi se-
querentur: cum ante Concilium Tridenti-
num non alio vinculo alligarentur Papæ, quàm
quod est subditorum, qui obnoxia capita subji-
ciunt suo Domino, atque imperium ejus Di-
vitiis & pompâ illustre suspiciunt, cujusque,
aut terrore, aut amore in obsequio & fide
continentur.
Unde non mirum sit tempore Lutheri, tanta
& tam magna facta fuerit in religione mu-
tatio desciscentibus populis turmatim, non
tam a imperio Papali quam à fide, quæ eum
nullibscripta aut certa esset, simul ac illa (qua-
iscunque tum ore tenus circumferebatur)
à Luthero

page.notes: Page number 184 and the handwritten-looking marks at top right are printed numbering; a small mark "7" at top right is a stray stain/annotation and is not transcribed. Words "extarct" and "Tridenti-num" and "Lutheri,tan-ta" are printed as they appear. Some words at the line ends near the bottom ("cum ore", "fidem") are faint; the readings given are best reading. Signature "A 4" is printed centre-left at the foot, and "Luthero" is the catchword at right.
